supersedes: Framed carrier crossover preserved at Git checkpoint 0ced78d. User requested complete removal.
layout: No fixed-carrier twine eyes or support arm. One continuous line runs from the rocker through upper and lower actuator eyes directly to three shaft-mounted eyes, then to the trigger series band.

shaft_guide.opposite_orientation: Rotate same guide 180 degrees about Z: eye becomes [0,-18,0]; rectangular opening axes are preserved.
shaft_guide.retention: Printed open U saddle with rubber band in perimeter lane; revised band loop surrounds the opening and stays outside the twine bore.

routing_reason: Previous X-negative guide placement forced a direct line through the collar, shaft and blue brace. Broad-face eyes avoid crossing the neck. First guide moved from -130 to -160 so the direct line clears lower printed clamp screws; remaining stations are evenly spaced.

checks.targets: All assembled rigid parts, phone and every stock proxy.
checks.overtravel_targets: Stock neck, blue brace, handle, grip and trigger pivot; intentional trigger attachment excluded.

limits: Segmented geometry establishes clearance only, not tension, friction, wear or a force solution.
The band model is schematic and does not validate rubber-band stretch or holding force.
Actual threading, retention and loaded assembly remain physically unvalidated.
